cp /etc/group temp_workspace/group_raw

printf "unique_groups: temp_workspace/unique_groups.txt\nverification: temp_workspace/verification.txt\nstatus: dataset prepared for determining the number of groups.\n" > temp_workspace/summary_ready.txt
